actions.reason: K4_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (coherent OXPHOS-down plus inflammatory/immune RNA program and a PBRM1-enriched/VHL-enriched/BAP1-depleted mutation pattern; ER:d2497140466c:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:e5313ac502, ER:d2497140466c:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:e5313ac502), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Evidence bearing directly on membership and boundary is weak or absent: current-label alignment is near zero in CT/WSI and small in RNA/WXS with within- and between-set distances nearly indistinguishable (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:e5313ac502), internal structure is single-cluster dominated with near-zero split silhouettes (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:set:e5313ac502), and the K4_C0001/K4_C0002 boundary is essentially unexpressed in fused geometry (boundary silhouette ~0.0004; ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:e51ef3599a) with only weak-to-modest native-geometry separation (ER:d2497140466c:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:e51ef3599a). A material alternative explanation remains: tissue_source_site and ct_manufacturer show nominal set-level association that does not survive correction but with substantial level imbalance (BP and GE concentration), so confounding cannot be dismissed (ER:d2497140466c:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:e5313ac502). Known-label correspondence is contextual only and does not supply retention evidence (ER:d2497140466c:known_label_echo:known_label_echo:partition:e3b0c44298). With decision-relevant membership/boundary evidence exhausted and no justified split or merge, independent retention is not positively justified.
